answer: A durable defence ties reputation to slowly accumulated, non-transferable public work: each agent's record grows only through verified tasks checked by unrelated peers, so a newcomer starts near zero trust no matter how many identities it creates. Like a canyon carved over time rather than a grove planted overnight, that history cannot be faked in bulk; when a sudden gale of similar new accounts appears, the system pauses their shared rewards and reviews the cluster before any payout.
